.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (known false positive: one criterion covering a whole flow)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (coverage has two directions; shared runtime policy vs task requirements)
evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map over instruction.md and all three /instructions notes against the 28 criteria (2 gates, 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual). Every stated requirement maps to at least one criterion: signed-out exposure (instruction.md:7, integration.md:44) -> authenticated_render + signin_and_client_scope Part A; client scope -> signin_and_client_scope Part B; wall on every route incl. list/thread/search/snippets/unread/transcript/direct not-available -> wall_every_route (functional/judge.toml:56); wall via mentions, link previews, @-suggestions -> wall_mentions_and_links (:71); live wall add/lift, partner-only -> wall_added_live (:87); 3-level replies, sent order under parent, quote -> nested_replies (:101); cross-matter reply -> wall_every_route leg 5 (JUDGE-W2/W3); placeholder for deleted/expired parents, author-only delete, exact 7-day boundary -> deleted_and_expired_messages (:114); timer options/display, shortening deletes at once incl. versions, edit doesn't rejuvenate, off/lengthen never restores, partner-only -> timer_changes (:133); hold scope, held undeletable, 'On hold' text, release deletes overdue, partner-only -> hold_scope_and_release (:148); edited mark, earlier versions literal, stale edit refused with typed text kept and reason in place, non-author edit refused, transcript edited mark, mentions follow edits/deletes -> edits_and_stale_edit (:165); bold/code/quote/new-tab links and literal markup in thread/quote/snippet/transcript -> safe_formatting (:184) (earlier versions in edits A1); message link preview/not-available when gone/opening -> message_links (:197) + highlight -> link_highlight (polish :48); unread per user, same in every tab, new-messages line, mark unread, deleted not counted -> unread_and_new_messages_line (:207) (walled unread in wall_every_route); idempotent resend and same-time order in thread/search/transcript -> sent_once_in_order (:221); live post/reply/edit/delete without losing draft/scroll/open reply -> live_updates_keep_my_work (:236); case-insensitive literal search, no old versions/deleted, click opens, transcript heading/order/author/UTC sent time/hold mark/versions/no controls -> search_and_transcript (:247); restart durability of messages, replies, edits+versions, timers, holds, walls, unread, deletions and no re-import (Survey booked count, Probate/Insurer) -> persistence (:268); Enter/Shift+Enter, Escape, delete confirm, refusal reason in place, transcript at 390px -> polish; phone thread width, hold/timer marks -> visual phone_thread/retention_marks. Launch-contract items (Node 22, relative paths, 0.0.0.0:3000, restricted env, DB_PATH, symlinks) are enforced by test.sh:76-112 (symlink -> zero reward, run from copy with env -i) rather than a criterion, which is the template's shared runtime policy. Bundled flows are the skill's documented false positive, not gaps. Notes (P3, no blocking gap): (1) only an https address is tested (functional/judge.toml:189), so an app linkifying https but not plain http would pass despite conversations.md:13; (2) 'GET /api/health answers 200 even if the database can't be opened' (integration.md:38) is not graded - test.sh probe_ready accepts any HTTP response from /api/health or / - but it is template runtime policy and not browser-observable; (3) new messages/edits carrying the fixed clock time is only indirectly graded (transcript 'own sent time' with app_context.md:29, plus boundary/timer behaviour); (4) the 390px no-sideways-scroll rule is binary-checked only on the transcript (transcript_phone) and graded for the thread only through the likert phone_thread anchors ('fit the width'). Broken-app probe: an http-only-unlinkified app or a health route that 500s on DB failure would pass; a conforming alternative is not failed by any coverage gap. This row is static source mapping; no runtime evidence is required for it.
